arguments.assumptions: FY2026 is Micron's disclosed 53-week fiscal year. Reported GAAP diluted EPS is $41.40 for the first 39 weeks ended 2026-05-28, using its reported diluted-share basis; grid applies a constant split-adjusted share basis solely for sensitivity. Annual EPS cases are analyst assumptions, not consensus: bear $70.00 (remaining 14-week EPS $28.60, below the $30.73 +/- $1.00 GAAP Q4 outlook, testing weaker memory pricing/volume or margin); base $72.00 (remaining $30.60, near the stated Q4 GAAP outlook); bull $74.00 (remaining $32.60, above guidance, requiring stronger AI-memory demand/pricing and execution). P/E inputs 12x/15x/18x are hypothetical stress inputs, not observed, fair, normal or probable multiples.

cases.rationale: Hypothetical miss: $28.60 residual GAAP EPS is below Q4 guidance, testing weaker memory demand/pricing or lower margin.
Hypothetical continuation: $30.60 residual GAAP EPS is near the stated Q4 GAAP EPS outlook.
Hypothetical beat: $32.60 residual GAAP EPS is above Q4 guidance and requires sustained AI-memory demand, pricing and margins.
